title: Make Add to your site and Start with the embed CTAs square
description: Unify the call-to-action button styling so both Add to your site and Start with the embed share a consistent, crisply square rounded-rectangle profile rather than a pill.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Unified .nav-cta ('Add to your site') and .button ('Start with the embed') with consistent square border radius profile (0.25rem / 4px), matching font-weight (800), and identical hover transitions. Verified with Behave and Playwright.
